description: This file is part of the Call addon plugin for Goteo, responsible for adding a custom route for project preview in calls and implementing HTTP basic authentication. It sets up autoload directories and registers event listeners within the application's service container.

classes.name: Goteo\Application\App
classes.description: Main application class providing access to the service container.

classes.name: Goteo\Application\Config
classes.description: Configuration class for managing autoload directories and other settings.

methods.name: Config::addAutoloadDir
methods.description: Adds a directory to the autoload paths for classes.

methods.name: App::getServiceContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the application's service container object.
